entries.question: I am first year student of b.tech. biomedical engineering and i want to do internship to learn more skill which is useful for us
entries.answer:
That's great that you're looking for internship opportunities to enhance your skills as a biomedical engineering student!

King George's Medical University (KGMU) offers various avenues for students to gain practical experience. Here's how you can explore internship possibilities:

*   **Paramedical Sciences:** KGMU has an Institute of Paramedical Sciences offering various diploma courses. While these are typically for specific paramedical diplomas, it's worth checking their website for any internship opportunities that might align with your biomedical engineering background. You can find more information here: [https://www.kgmu.org/paramedical_about_faculty.php](https://www.kgmu.org/paramedical_about_faculty.php)

*   **Research Opportunities:** Biomedical engineering often involves research. KGMU has a strong focus on research, with various departments and research cells. You might find opportunities in departments like Anatomy, Biochemistry, Physiology, or others that conduct research relevant to biomedical engineering. You can explore the research-related sections of the KGMU website:
    *   **Research & Innovation:** [https://www.kgmu.org/research.php](https://www.kgmu.org/research.php)
    *   **Intramural Projects:** [https://www.kgmu.org/intramural_project.php](https://www.kgmu.org/intramural_project.php)

*   **Specific Departments:** Depending on your specific interests within biomedical engineering (e.g., medical imaging, diagnostics, rehabilitation), you might find relevant departments to explore. You can browse the list of departments here: [https://www.kgmu.org/department.php](https://www.kgmu.org/department.php)

**To find out about specific internship openings or to inquire about possibilities, I recommend the following:**

1.  **Visit the KGMU Website:** Thoroughly explore the sections mentioned above for any "Internship," "Student Opportunities," or "Career" related information.
2.  **Contact Departments Directly:** If you identify departments whose research or work aligns with your interests, you can try to find their contact information on the KGMU website and reach out to them directly to inquire about internship possibilities.
3.  **Check the "Career" or "Job Opportunities" Section:** Sometimes, internship openings are listed under career or job sections. You can check here: [https://www.kgmu.org/job.php](https://www.kgmu.org/job.php)

It's a good idea to have your resume and a brief cover letter ready, outlining your skills and what you hope to learn during an internship. Good luck with your internship search!

entries.question: K.g.m.u. addmission ke liye kaun sa entrance test dena hoga
entries.answer:
KGMU mein admission lene ke liye, aapko course ke aadhar par alag-alag entrance test dena hoga.

**Undergraduate Courses (MBBS, BDS, B.Sc. Nursing, B.Sc. Radiotherapy):**
In courses ke liye admission UP NEET UG ya All India NEET UG ke through hota hai. Kuch seats Government of India ke nominees ke liye bhi reserved hoti hain.

**Postgraduate Courses (MD, MS, MDS, DM, MCH, PG Diploma, M.Phil, M.Sc. Nursing, MHA, MHPE):**
In courses ke liye admission UPPGMEE (Uttar Pradesh Postgraduate Medical Entrance Examination) aur AIPGMEE (All India Post Graduate Medical Entrance Examination) ke through hota hai.

**Diploma and Certificate Courses:**
KGMU mein Dental Hygiene aur Dental Mechanics jaise certificate courses bhi offer kiye jaate hain, jinke liye alag se entrance examination hota hai.

**Ph.D. Program:**
Ph.D. mein admission ke liye alag se entrance test hota hai.

Aapko kis specific course mein admission lene mein ruchi hai, yeh batane se main aapko adhik jaankari de paunga. Aap KGMU ki official website www.kgmu.org par bhi latest admission notices aur eligibility criteria check kar sakte hain.
